text:
Kira (CSM): quick weekly sync for Sycamore Labs (private VPC) — sharing top-level health notes so we can decide actions. Usage +35% WoW, spend trending up (~+28%), and a latency blip in ap-southeast-1 yesterday that triggered automatic fallback to eu-west-1.

Devon (Infra): noted. Do we have the per-region uptime numbers for the period?

Kira (CSM): yes — last 7d: eu-west-1 99.98%, us-west-2 99.99%, ap-southeast-1 99.21% (most of the drop during a 40m window).

Jenna (SE): ap-southeast-1 spike corresponds with a KMS rotation job in the customer's KMS cluster. We saw ~0.6% decrypt errors at peak, then auto-retry resolved most. I have a snippet from logs:```
2026-06-10T03:12:45Z redispatch: request id=aa3f.. status=failed decrypt_error
2026-06-10T03:12:46Z retrying request id=aa3f.. status=ok latency=340ms
```

Sam (Oncall): @kms-bot did we surface an alert?

kms-bot: Alert: KMS transient errors detected for sycamore-prod in ap-southeast-1. Severity: low -> escalated to INFO after retries. Incident link: <https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-20260610-9876>

Devon (Infra): root cause looks like intermittent network path to customer KMS HSM endpoints — packet loss from our edge in ap-southeast-1 during that window. We rerouted some traffic and latency dropped back. We should propose a fallback for KMS region to avoid full-decrypt failures.

Kira (CSM): customer notes: their infra team ran key rotation at 03:10 which overlapped with our rolling infra updates. They flagged this as a "coordination risk" ahead of renewal. Renewal sentiment still neutral-positive but this is a risk vector.

Jenna (SE): Recommended actions: 1) Add explicit KMS-region fallback policy for Sycamore (primary ap-southeast-1, fallback eu-west-1). 2) Expand decrypt retry window for the next 72h. 3) Run a scheduled KMS chaos test with customer in a maintenance window.

Devon (Infra): timeline: I can push a routing + fallback policy tonight to staging and schedule rollback if we see anything. Command to check KMS key health I used: ``redwoodctl kms status --account sycamore --region ap-southeast-1``

Kira (CSM): I'll coordinate with Sycamore's infra lead (cc @SycamoreInfra in convo) to propose a maintenance window and get buy-in. Also sharing dashboard: <https://dash.redwood.ai/accounts/sycamore|Sycamore dashboard> — pay attention to token spend and per-route latency.

Sam (Oncall): FYI we saw a small spike in cache misses during the failover — KV cache miss rate went from 2.4% to 9.1% for 15m, which added ~120ms tail latency. Not service impacting but visible.

Kira (CSM): capture action items: [Kira] coordinate maintenance window, [Devon] push fallback + retry tuning to staging, [Jenna] prepare runbook for KMS failover scenario, [Sam] monitor KV cache miss behavior post-change.

Devon (Infra): estimated CI->Prod push: staging tonight 11pm UTC, prod tomorrow 02:00 UTC (low-traffic window).

Jenna (SE): I'll add a short eval to Redwood Optimize to check token cost delta after fallback (we want to avoid unexpected cost bump).

Kira (CSM): renewal note: flagging this as "watch" — we will include mitigation plan in renewal packet. Positive items to highlight: usage growth and adoption of private deployment features; request a quote on Dedicated capacity as backup if latency SLAs become a top ask.

Sam (Oncall): I'll set an alert to drop to P2 if decrypt errors >0.5% for more than 10m post-deploy.

Kira (CSM): thanks team. I'll post a short summary to the weekly account health doc and ping Sycamore for OK on maintenance window. :thumbsup:
